identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Aiper US product pages. Scuba S1 Pro, Aiper Scuba S1, EcoSurfer S2 and Aiper Surfer S1 are four separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no company focus was added; Aiper still has no company-authored focus review. The reviewed pages publish no price, so the catalog ~1,099, 799, ~400 and ~400 USD prices are cleared. The catalog medium and small size labels are cleared because no robot dimensions are published. The catalog 7.3 kg and 3.4 kg masses are cleared because no robot mass is published. Battery and runtime values are documented only where the page publishes them: 180 min for both Scuba models, 35 hours for EcoSurfer S2 and 20 hours for Aiper Surfer S1; the catalog 180 min, 35 hr and up to 12 hours labels are replaced or cleared. Charging times of 4 hours, 3-4 hours and 4-6 hours are documented where published; Aiper Surfer S1 publishes none.

fields.description: The Aiper Scuba S1 Pro is a robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pools up to 2,150 sq.ft (200 m2) and 66 ft (20 m) in length, with a 6,000 GPH (22,740 LPH) suction and flow rate, a 5 L top-load debris basket with 180 um and 3 um MicroMesh filtration, and four brushless motors. It cleans for up to 180 minutes and charges in 4 hours, with WaveLine horizontal waterline cleaning, WavePath 2.0 navigation and a wireless charging dock. The page publishes no price, robot mass, robot dimensions, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~1,099 USD price and medium size label are cleared.

highlights: The Aiper Scuba S1 Pro is a robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pools up to 2,150 sq.ft (200 m2) with a 6,000 GPH flow rate.
It uses four brushless motors, a 5 L top-load debris basket and 180 um plus 3 um MicroMesh filtration.
It cleans for up to 180 minutes and charges in 4 hours.
WaveLine horizontal waterline cleaning and WavePath 2.0 navigation support the cleaning run.
The catalog ~1,099 USD price and medium size label are cleared because the page publishes no price or robot dimensions.

fields.description: The Aiper Scuba S1 is a robotic pool cleaner for above-ground and in-ground pools up to 1,600 sq.ft (150 m2) and 50 ft (15 m) in length, with a 4,200 GPH (15,900 LPH) suction and flow rate, a 5 L debris basket and up to 180 minutes runtime. It charges in 3-4 hours and uses WavePath 2.0 navigation with expanded 12-inch shallow area cleaning and 1.6-inch obstacle crossing. The page publishes no price, robot mass, robot dimensions, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width; the catalog 799 USD price, 7.3 kg mass and medium size label are cleared.

highlights: The Aiper Scuba S1 is a robotic pool cleaner for above-ground and in-ground pools up to 1,600 sq.ft (150 m2).
It filters up to 4,200 GPH (15,900 LPH) through a 5 L debris basket and runs for up to 180 minutes.
Charging takes 3-4 hours, and WavePath 2.0 navigation covers floors, walls and the waterline.
Expanded 12-inch shallow area cleaning and 1.6-inch obstacle crossing extend the cleaning coverage.
The catalog 799 USD price, 7.3 kg mass and medium size label are cleared because the page publishes none of them.

fields.description: The Aiper EcoSurfer S2 is a robotic pool skimmer with a 4 L top-load debris basket, 150 um filtration, 35 hours of battery life with adapter charging and 4-6 hours charging time. It uses two brushless propellers and one brushless impeller, DebrisGuard, a built-in chlorine dispenser and SolarSeeker, with optical obstacle sensors and high-temperature and UV resistance. The page publishes no price, robot mass, robot dimensions, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, water tank capacity or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~400 USD price, small size label and 35 hr runtime value are replaced or cleared.
